test_title: PYST 06: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 07 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: What did the Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act 2009 in India lay down?

options.text: Legal underpinnings for achieving universal higher education
Legal underpinnings for achieving vocational education
Legal underpinnings for achieving universal elementary education
Legal underpinnings for achieving quality and excellence in education

solution:
The correct answer is __**Legal underpinnings for achieving universal elementary education**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act 2009** (RTE Act) was enacted by the Parliament of India.
 
• The act provides for **free and compulsory education** to all children aged between **6 to 14 years**.
 
• It aims to ensure that every child has access to **elementary education** of satisfactory and equitable quality.
 
• The RTE Act mandates that no child shall be held back, expelled, or required to pass a board examination until the completion of elementary education.
 
• It also lays down norms and standards related to **pupil-teacher ratios, buildings and infrastructure, school-working days, and teacher-working hours**.
 
• The act includes provisions for a **child-friendly and child-centered approach** to education.
 
• The RTE Act places the responsibility on the government to ensure the enrollment, attendance, and completion of **elementary education** by every child.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Legal underpinnings for achieving universal higher education**__

 __
 
• Higher education refers to the stage of learning that occurs at universities, academies, colleges, seminaries, and institutes of technology.
 
• It typically includes undergraduate and postgraduate education.
 
 
 
• **Legal underpinnings for achieving vocational education**__
 __
 
• Vocational education is training that equips individuals with practical skills and knowledge related to specific trades, occupations, or vocations.
 
• It is often oriented towards direct entry into a particular occupation or trade.
 
 
 
• **Legal underpinnings for achieving quality and excellence in education**__
 
 
• This refers to policies and measures aimed at improving the overall quality and standards of education at various levels.
 
• It may involve curriculum development, teacher training, infrastructure improvement, and performance assessments.\
